name: West Virginia
agency: West Virginia Division of Motor Vehicles (WV DMV)
permitAge: 15 (Level 1 GDL instruction permit, ages 15 to under 18); a parent or legal guardian signs consent form DMV-DS-23P (married applicants exempt). Handbook p9.

teen.supervisedHours: 50 hours behind the wheel, including 10 at night, certified by a parent or legal guardian log sheet; or an approved driver education course (handbook p10; W. Va. Code 17B-2-3a)
teen.holdPermit: 180 consecutive days conviction-free on Level 1 before Level 2 (handbook p10); minimum age 16 for Level 2
teen.nightLimit: Level 1: drive only 5 a.m. to 10 p.m. Level 2: unsupervised only 5 a.m. to 10 p.m.; 10 p.m. to 5 a.m. needs a licensed driver 21 or older, except work, school-sanctioned activity, religious activity or emergency (handbook p10)
teen.passengerLimit: Level 1: no more than two additional non-family passengers besides the supervisor (p10). Level 2: first six months no non-family passengers under 20; second six months no more than one non-family passenger under 20 (p11)
teen.phone: Drivers under 18 (all GDL levels): no wireless device except to call 911 (p11; 17B-2-3a). All drivers: no holding a phone; calls hands-free or voice-operated only (p17; 17C-14-15).

bac.under21: 0.02 (misdemeanor, 17C-5-2(j)); handbook p21 calls this zero tolerance. Level 1 and Level 2 holders: no measurable alcohol (p10, p11)

notes: Handbook: West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook, cover 'Revised 07/2026' (PDF created 2026-08-04), linked from https://dmv.wv.gov/driver-services/drivers/drivers-licensing-handbooks. No Spanish handbook found on the DMV site. Part of the PDF text uses an oddly encoded font; it was decoded for checking. Printed page = PDF page minus 10; the definitions pages are unnumbered.

Knowledge test (handbook p24): at least 25 questions; 19 of 25 correct to pass; timed; audio version with headphones available. The handbook and DMV pages checked do not say which languages the test is offered in.
Retest (handbook p26, 17B-2-6): not twice within one week; DMV online-test page says wait seven days. $7.50 per attempt (p10).

Online 'Know to Drive' knowledge test (https://dmv.wv.gov/what-you-should-know): needs a webcam and a mouse; not on a phone or touch screen; under 18 needs an adult 18+ at registration; passing score valid six months.
Level 1 supervisor: licensed driver 21 or older in the front passenger seat (p9); statute adds driver-ed instructor and 'only other occupant of the front seat' (17B-2-3a).
Level 3 full license at 17 after 12 months conviction-free on Level 2 (p12).

Move over law (17C-14-9a, amended 2024 and 2025): any stationary vehicle showing flashing red/blue/amber lights, hazard lights, flares or warning signs: change to a non-adjacent lane on 4+ lane highways if safe, otherwise slow to no more than 15 mph (nondivided) or 25 mph (divided). Not in the handbook. Up to $500 and/or 60 days jail.
School bus (handbook p50; 17C-12-7): traffic in both directions stops; only on interstate highways does oncoming traffic not stop. No question written.
